title: Audit PR4483's sharp cancellation threshold with exact extremisers (no new kappa)
body:
## Upstream publication and complete scope

Publishes [fork PR #16](https://github.com/Clear1nsight/integer-mult-bounds/pull/16), preserving exact verified head `0898b3a8faa5b809d2beedc99dce5d69574568e4`. Publication comparison was refreshed against upstream `f626db5c3a3d781d8f7695038776c621651f75e1` on 22 October 2026: **16 changed files, 3 contribution commits**. The scientific package is isolated in its own directory, but the complete upstream diff also carries the shared historical-replay/source-role and navigation/CI repairs from its preparation base, plus the base documentation. Shared repair bytes overlap across fork #14–#18 and must be reconciled once; they are not independent scientific contributions. All five research heads have successful exact-head fork workflows. Opening this PR is not a new scientific replay, upstream CI pass, merge or theorem acceptance. Scientific source pins, attribution and scope limitations are retained.

---

## Change and mathematical scope

Assignment D independently audits one quantified implication in zxv's PR4483 Section 4. The all-real proof corroborates the cancellation threshold and characterises its sharp universal guarantee at fixed net production and leaf mass. It handles zero mass without division and gives explicit rejected root/leaf omission examples. These are failures of weakened tests, not bugs in PR4483. No new kappa, compiler rank or full compiler admission is claimed.

For I=B+F+A, 0<=beta<eta<1 and nonnegative potentials with B<=beta I, the exact identity is

```text
(1-beta)(eta I-B-F)
 = (eta-beta)A-(1-eta)F+(1-eta)(beta I-B).
```

The largest allowed exit fraction at fixed A,F is `(beta*A+F)/(A+F)`, attained by the stated extremiser. Necessity concerns a guarantee over all admissible boundary masses, not each individual flow. PROOF.md binds A to the source's net production including its root debit.

Targeted searches and bounded Discussion reading are not exhaustive overlap pagination. The historical baseline helper was not run.

The scientific contribution remains pinned to its isolated preparation base. This upstream submission preserves the exact verified head; no merge or selected-frontier change is requested.

## Validation

**Final-head hosted workflow [39724661544](https://github.com/Clear1nsight/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/39724661544) passes at `0898b3a8faa5b809d2beedc99dce5d69574568e4`.** Onboarding, package metadata/source authentication, source-bound scientific replay, optimised controls and committed-input preservation pass on Ubuntu with CPython 3.12.15, standard library only.

RESULT.json retains 6,120 rational cases, 1,800 attained extremisers, 120 zero-mass cases, four invalid-premise controls, nine coefficient checks and both omission witnesses. Normal replay compares every retained result field. The universal conclusion comes from the written identity and extremal argument, not extrapolation of the grid. No predecessor acceptance function is imported.

```sh
python -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/adaptive-cancellation-audit
python -I -O -B research/adaptive-cancellation-audit/verify.py --self-test
```

Chernoff/root estimates, mirror certification, funded majorant, chronological native realisation, physical costs, precision/stock and outer transfer remain separate. No full selected cold replay, optional source-history preflight, formal-kernel or independent human verification was run.

## Open next questions

A better contraction must use stronger actual-flow information than these scalar premises, or a better mirror/leaf bound. First prove one source-bound joint occupation inequality and compare it with the extremisers. A separate audit of a Chernoff/root estimate or PR4532's critical-endpoint argument remains distinct. Refresh overlap before claiming it. README.md, PROOF.md, TASK.json and the public handoff record the exact boundaries.
